confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant, cafe and bar anchors are moderately confident; July hostel and hotel rates vary widely by date and demand and are the least certain. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (roughly 1.8x and 1.3x). Local EUR prices were converted at a working assumption of about 1.16 USD per EUR, not a sourced rate. The FX figure is from the RBA exchange-rates table as surfaced by search; cached date labels did not fully reconcile, so verify on the live page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Nordic capital pricing: restaurant and bar levels roughly in line with Stockholm and below Oslo and Copenhagen; budget lodging sits above Tallinn-level pricing. July lodging uses summer peak-season levels.
